source.name: Accra Metro public property-identification app
source.operator: Accra Metro app (page title ACCRA METRO, labels AMA) hosted by Berry ICT; app ownership/authority not independently established
source.scope: App claims Accra Metro scope; actual first-record sample area only; no citywide completeness established
source.geometry: Three first complete records are MultiPolygons, with application fields `parcelid` and `parcelcode` (generic `id` is a row ID). Stable/native identifier semantics remain unverified.
source.access: Public HTML/JS fetched with en-GH headers and AMA Referer. POST request with Range bytes=0-32767 plus 32 KiB hard cap returned HTTP 200; Range ignored and transfer aborted at 32768 bytes. Three complete records were sanitized to parcelid, parcelcode, and geometry; generic id field excluded as row ID. Full response not saved.
source.assessment: Partial sample geometry lead from the Accra Metro app. Three complete polygons are within a compact ~350 m aggregate bbox, but the request had no spatial filter and lies about 8 km south of WUP center; it does not establish center-area coverage, completeness, or adapter readiness.

"Kumasi" cadastral parcel GIS Ghana Lands Commission
searchBatches.assessment: Queries executed; searches did not by themselves verify target polygon geometry.

requests.assessment: Page and JS inspected; app JavaScript identified general_php_scripts/load_data.php as the parcel-table endpoint. A later capped-prefix POST was made; see the following request record for its HTTP 200 response and the fact that Range was ignored.

Request body tbl=parcel&flds=*&where=1=1; Range bytes=0-32767 was ignored; 32 KiB client cap aborted transfer. Three complete prefix features saved with only id+geometry. No spatial filter was applied.

limitations: These observations only support the named scope and cannot establish countrywide absence or coverage.
